findings.summary: The site does not adapt to the user’s dark colour-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-mode screenshot is visually identical to the light screenshot, and the DOM/CSS inspection found no dark theme response.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and provide dark surface, text, border and image treatments through prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visibly indicated and several controls are smaller than the recommended target size.
findings.evidence: The active focus probe reported outline-style none and no focus box-shadow for the first 20 controls. It also measured the 34x23 menu button, 34x29 notice link and 12x12 disclosure button below 44x44 CSS px.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a high-contrast :focus-visible ring and enlarge compact controls with padding/min-inline-size/min-block-size while preserving layout.

findings.summary: The entry experience is dominated by promotional image banners rather than scannable content.
findings.evidence: The first mobile viewport stacks two dense promotional raster banners before notices or benefit navigation; much of the core offer is embedded in images rather than structured text.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace image-baked offer copy with semantic text, keep one primary campaign visual, and move secondary promotions below task-oriented navigation.

findings.summary: Load performance and visual stability are far outside good Core Web Vitals ranges.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 14.4 s, CLS 0.942, TBT 480 ms and performance 0.23. The raw trace measured LCP 10.73 s; layout observers measured CLS 1.069 on home mobile and 0.857 on coupons.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve intrinsic image space, prioritize the actual LCP image, lazy-load below-fold assets, and stop late banner/carousel insertion.

findings.summary: The homepage ships a heavy, poorly cached dependency graph.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 164 requests and 5,009,585 transferred bytes, including 2.44 MB images and 2.31 MB scripts. Ten parser-inserted stylesheets were VeryHigh-priority render-blocking candidates and large hero/banner images lacked cache headers.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate critical CSS, defer non-critical styles, set long immutable caching on versioned assets, and remove the initial redirect chain.

findings.summary: Key controls and images lack accessible names, and the heading hierarchy has no page-level H1.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed button-name, image-alt and heading-order. It identified two unnamed buttons and an image without alt; the DOM/UI probe found zero H1 elements and image audit found 37 images without alt.
findings.suggestedFix: Name icon-only buttons, use alt="" for decorative images and meaningful alt for content images, add one descriptive H1, and repair sequential heading levels.

findings.summary: Third-party integrations produce runtime console errors.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse logged a Yahoo CORS failure and an uncaught ReferenceError: ga is not defined from GTM.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove stale analytics tags, load dependencies in a defined order, and treat third-party script failures as isolated optional failures.

findings.summary: Tracking and third-party execution are disproportionate for a public landing page.
findings.evidence: Tracker inspection found 39 third-party origins and nine known tracker domains. HAR attributed 79 requests and 2.27 MB to third parties, while Lighthouse estimated 1,114 KiB of unused JavaScript, much of it analytics/ad code.
findings.suggestedFix: Inventory each vendor, remove redundant pixels/tag containers, gate optional analytics on consent, and batch/minimize measurement events.

findings.summary: Non-JavaScript crawlers receive essentially no page content, and robots.txt is missing.
findings.evidence: Discoverability analysis found 0% rendered-content coverage in raw HTML and the crawler screenshot is blank, despite a populated browser view. /robots.txt returned Not Found; raw HTML contained only 41 text characters.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render or statically render meaningful headings, offer copy and navigation; publish a valid robots.txt linked consistently with the sitemap.

findings.summary: Cookie and response-header defenses are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers lacked HSTS, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy, while CSP only declared frame-ancestors. Cookie inspection found 12 of 13 cookies insecure, including analytics cookies without Secure and many SameSite=None cookies.
findings.suggestedFix: Set HSTS, a full nonce/hash-based CSP, strict Referrer-Policy and least-privilege Permissions-Policy; mark every HTTPS cookie Secure and use Lax/Strict unless cross-site use is required.

findings.summary: Optional network integrations fail noisily instead of degrading cleanly.
findings.evidence: HAR captured a 400 analytics response, ORB-blocked scripts and multiple aborted/failed tracker requests; Lighthouse also exposed the resulting console errors.
findings.suggestedFix: Make third-party dependencies conditional and failure-isolated, suppress retries for blocked analytics, and preserve core UI when optional requests fail.

findings.summary: Image and media delivery wastes bandwidth.
findings.evidence: Image audit found 100 images without width/height attributes, 96 below-fold images without lazy loading, 21 oversized images, 42 without srcset and 10 legacy formats. HAR transferred 2.44 MB of images, including a 516 KB GIF.
findings.suggestedFix: Encode raster content as AVIF/WebP, provide srcset/sizes, set intrinsic dimensions, lazy-load below-fold imagery, and replace animated GIFs with efficient video or still media.

findings.summary: The linked manifest is not installable and there is no active service worker.
findings.evidence: Manifest contains only display:"browser" and one icon, with no name, start_url or standalone display; the UI probe reported no controlling service worker.
findings.suggestedFix: If installability is intended, provide a complete manifest and service-worker offline fallback; otherwise remove app-like manifest signalling.

findings.summary: The initial page has a large memory footprint for a marketing/content surface.
findings.evidence: A post-load heap summary contained 730,531 nodes, 3,239,793 edges, 42.4 MB self size and 53,114 closures; the network evidence also shows a large analytics/script population.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove redundant analytics runtimes, load optional widgets on demand, and profile retained constructors after tag consolidation.
